cases.name: std-decimal-add-sub-mul-are-exact
cases.source:
import "std:decimal" as dec
def show(a) { return dec.to_string(a) }
print(show(dec.add(dec.parse("0.1"), dec.parse("0.2"))), 0.1 + 0.2)
print(show(dec.mul(dec.parse("19.99"), dec.from_int(3))))
print(show(dec.sub(dec.parse("1"), dec.parse("0.005"))))
print(show(dec.mul(dec.parse("1.10"), dec.parse("2.5"))), dec.scale(dec.mul(dec.parse("1.10"), dec.parse("2.5"))))
print(show(dec.add(dec.parse("1.5"), dec.parse("-1.50"))))
